bias: Most US cash proxies are still showing Friday's close 22 minutes ahead of the open, so today's real signal is in the instruments that trade overnight: yields firmed further (10Y +0.38%, 30Y +0.46%), the dollar eased modestly, and VIX picked up +5.61% off its recent cycle lows — the first real uptick in equity vol in weeks, though still low in absolute terms. Oil's third straight up day (+0.76% to $83.03, ~+4% cumulative) is the more persistent watch item, but breakevens and DFII5 both sat flat, so this reads as a real-rate/term-premium drift rather than an inflation scare.
